2609.31318.title: AgentXploit: Autonomous Repository-to-Runtime Red-Teaming for AI Agents
2609.31318.paper_summary: AI agents combine language models with external data and tools that can modify files, call APIs, or execute code. Security failures can arise when adversarial content changes an agent's tool use or when the surrounding software contains vulnerabilities such as path traversal or command injection. We study authorized white-box pre-deployment auditing, where the auditor has access to the target repository and a controlled runtime, but successful attacks must still act through the task-defined attacker interface and be confirmed by an external verifier. We present AgentXploit, a two-role auditing system that separates repository-level attack-path discovery from runtime exploitation. The Analyzer Agent traces attacker-controlled inputs to sensitive operations and records code-supported candidate attack paths; the Exploiter Agent turns these paths into concrete attacks and revises them using runtime feedback. We also introduce AgentXploit-Bench, containing 72 reproducible vulnerabilities across 12 open-source AI-agent systems and frameworks. Across three runs, AgentXploit reaches 59.3% end-to-end success, compared with 38.4% for Codex. Under a token-budget-matched comparison, Codex reaches 46.3%. On AgentDojo, where injection points are provided, the Exploiter Agent reaches 79.2% attack success versus 52.7% for AgentVigil. These results highlight repository discovery and runtime exploitation as distinct challenges in end-to-end agent security auditing.
2609.31318.paper_summary_zh: AI代理結合了語言模型與可以修改檔案、調用API或執行代碼的外部數據和工具。當對抗性內容改變代理的工具使用，或當周圍的軟體存在如路徑遍歷或命令注入等漏洞時，可能會出現安全失敗。我們研究授權的白盒預部署審計，其中審計員可以訪問目標庫和受控運行時，但成功的攻擊仍必須通過任務定義的攻擊者介面進行，並需由外部驗證者確認。我們提出了AgentXploit，一個兩角色的審計系統，將庫級攻擊路徑發現與運行時利用分開。分析代理追蹤攻擊者控制的輸入到敏感操作，並記錄代碼支持的候選攻擊路徑；利用代理將這些路徑轉化為具體攻擊，並使用運行時反饋進行修正。我們還介紹了AgentXploit-Bench，包含72個可重現的漏洞，遍及12個開源AI代理系統和框架。在三次運行中，AgentXploit達到了59.3%的端到端成功率，而Codex為38.4%。在與代幣預算匹配的比較中，Codex達到了46.3%。在提供注入點的AgentDojo上，利用代理的攻擊成功率達到79.2%，而AgentVigil為52.7%。這些結果突顯了庫發現和運行時利用作為端到端代理安全審計中的不同挑戰。
